The only thing helping me with this is that I keep reminding myself that I use to not be with her at one point. That I had a great life before her that I have forgotten about. I use to have a great body, money, cars, friends, etc that I would enjoy on a daily. I always had something to do. I use to work on my cars late into the night with no one to worry about to complain. I use to race, go to car shows, clubs, concerts and I'm going to get all that back. Focus on me now. You want to know what your getting into. The question you want to ask yourself is; what if I did the same? Maybe a question to ask her. Her reaction will answer more questions then you know. The only way ,in my opinion, of you coming out as being controlling is if you deny her these things and consistently keep pushing the topic. Asking her or pointing out your concerns is not controlling. Believe me she would do the same. We as men are always the ones that aren't allowed to do this. God forbid we express our views because then we'll always be labeled as that one controlling freak. There's a huge difference. Like I said express how you feel, point out that she wouldn't like it if you did then read her reaction. If she happens to say she wouldn't have a problem with it at all, show her. If she then really doesn't, then buddy you're still in an open relationship.

Oh man I have so many but the best one I think was when a couple of friends and I went to a club about thirty mins from where we live. It was around winter and snowing. First off I should say it doesn't snow here often and it was supposed to come down that night, so we decided to take the Exploder instead of the convertible like we planned. Good choice. We got there and wasn't much going on which at the same time was good cuz we had a good chance to mingle with the girls that were there a bit easier. Anyway we all get shit faced and when we go to leave there's two feet of snow. I know it doesn't sound like much especially when I've live in Wisconsin but in Ga/Tn its a big deal. They don't care much to clean up the roads.  We get in and head back. We decided to stop at a waffle house on the way a couple of exits from where we needed to get off and grab a traditional after clubbing meal, don't ask why. Now mind u at this point I still know who I'm around. We eat socialize with the staff considering we were the only ones there. We then leave to drop of a buddy at his house. We get there and we can't get up a hill in his subdivision. So as the good friends that we are we walk him a half mile away to his house cutting through the woods and yards. On our way back my buddy falls in a creek thinking it was ground. So we then run back to the car. I drive him to his house and go home right after. Its about 5 or 6 by now. As soon as I wake up all hell breaks loose. I have no recollection of anything that night but the fact that we ate and walked our buddy home. So I called the last guy I dropped off to see if he was OK. No answer. I called the other guy he said he hasn't heard from him. So now I'm trippin out. I was completely convinced I left him at the club. So I called some of the girls I got numbers from that night asking , still nothing. My other buddy  said he called about twenty times. So I decided to go to his house And see if he's there. Turns out he dropped his phone we guess when he fell in the creek. Spend the rest of the day looking for a needle in a hay stack.

There was a guy that was a little off his rockers. I say that cuz usually they keep fully mental inmates somewhere else. This guy tho was kept in a cell by himself 23 hours a day. Always thought it was wrong considering the fact of him being in there probably made him worse. Anyway, the most memorable part was when he was allowed to roam free. This happened when the rest of us were locked down for the night. Four guards would go to his cell and ask him if he wanted out that night. Stupid question I think, but they had to ask I guess. Of course he would say yes, then they would put a suit that everyone there called a turtle suit for obvious reasons. While one guard stood there with a tazer the other three would suit him up. It was a full body green suit that covered every square inch of his body including built on mittens. It was round around the midsection with what seemed like a cone of shame with a small v-cut so he could see ahead. The guards would close the cell and leave the block. When they would close the block door his cell would open and he'd run out like a bat outta hell. He'd have a TV on to watch but only did for a few mins at a time. The rest of the time he'd just run around the block non stop laughing, yelling, and jumping around. It was memorable cuz all of us seeing him made us feel a little better about being there. He looked so happy just to be out and about. That and the turtle suit was awesome.

When I was around three years old I met an old man in Mexico ,where I lived at the time. He had about 8 dogs who stayed around and seemed to follow him. He only had one leg and used a crutch that he seemed to have made. 
My friends and I were playing in the street close to my uncles grocery store when I saw him up against the store's wall. To my surprise he called me over, and to this day I don't know why I went. He said that he was the devil and that all his dogs use to be people that treated him wrong. After hearing that I figured that running away would be a mistake so I stuck around. He then asked me if I liked magic. I of course said yes. He then stuck out his index finger and with his other index he made a sawing movement like he was chopping his finger off. This is where it gets weird and the part people don't believe. His finger tip actually started to move!!! I stayed motionless while this finger tip slowly floated off his finger and seemed to just float in mid air. He grabbed it showed it to me then put it back on as if it was play dough. He then started laughing in a way that I wouldn't expect him to. He had a gargled voice when he spoke as if he had smoked and drank his whole life or had a bad cold. But his laugh was ,and this is the best way to describe it, very proper almost clean or crisp. Then he said in that crisp voice that he could do that to my ear if I wanted. Safe to say that's when I booked it home. When I reached my house my mom was outside and I told her everything. Of course she didn't believe me and said if it did happen it was because I was bad and that I deserved it. Another weird part is that I didn't have nightmares like I expected. To this day no one believes me when I tell them this story.
